policyName: EVM swaps on allowlisted chains and routers
notes: Replace <ROUTER_ALLOWLIST> with the router addresses from ROUTER_ALLOWLIST_JSON. Native value cap is 2000000000000000 wei. One-time token approvals are a root-quorum ceremony, not this policy.
condition: activity.kind == 'SIGN_TRANSACTION' && (eth.tx.chain_id == 1 || eth.tx.chain_id == 10 || eth.tx.chain_id == 56 || eth.tx.chain_id == 137 || eth.tx.chain_id == 324 || eth.tx.chain_id == 8453 || eth.tx.chain_id == 42161 || eth.tx.chain_id == 59144 || eth.tx.chain_id == 81457 || eth.tx.chain_id == 534352 || eth.tx.chain_id == 4663 || eth.tx.chain_id == 999) && eth.tx.value <= 2000000000000000 && (eth.tx.to == '<ROUTER_ALLOWLIST>')

policyName: Solana swaps through Jupiter and the base programs
notes: Add each DEX program id Jupiter puts in the transaction, or Turnkey denies the sign. Program ids must be static. Address lookup tables cannot supply program ids.
condition: activity.kind == 'SIGN_TRANSACTION' && solana.tx.program_keys.all(p, p == 'JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4' || p == '11111111111111111111111111111111' || p == 'ComputeBudget111111111111111111111111111111' || p == 'TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA' || p == 'TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb' || p == 'ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL')

notes: The L1 action is hashed into connectionId before EIP-712, so this policy can pin the Agent domain and cannot see withdraw3. The app rejects non-tradable actions before it submits.
